decisions.reason: The source changes commission allocation for purchases without a referral code; coded-referral commissions already remain $10 and continue going to the referrer.

The source leaves no-referral ticket issuance unresolved, and that same-message ambiguity is already represented in this Requirement; the confirmed $10 commission rule does not resolve or otherwise modify the ticket rule.
The decision concerns commission allocation on code-free purchases and does not change ticket issuance for purchases using a valid referral code.

The retained FAQ commission content already uses a $10 amount, and the source does not explicitly require new FAQ copy; no current top-level FAQ attribute is necessarily changed by this amount correction.
The landing-page commission copy describes the unchanged $10 coded-referral reward and does not specify the recipient of commissions from no-referral purchases.
Changing the no-referral commission amount to $10 does not alter the Small Block prize amount, winners, trigger, eligibility, or prize-pool allocation.
The source does not change how an NFT's referral code is assigned, persisted, or displayed.
The source changes the disposition of a commission after a no-referral purchase, not which referral identifiers are valid or whether self-referrals are allowed.
The revenue split already specifies a $10 commission allocation per mint; the source changes the recipient-selection path for no-referral mints rather than the retained split amounts.
The source requires a weighted draw but does not specify Chainlink VRF or change the provider and applicability rules for prize-winner selection.
No-referral commission allocation does not change which book access, referral identity, badges, or prize tickets follow an NFT after transfer.
The commission decision does not change Small Block ticket eligibility, expiration, burning, reset, or carry-forward behavior.
